G.A., Satyendra Kumar Singh 
 Court No. - 46
 Hon'Ble Rajiv Gupta, J. 
Hon'Ble Harvir Singh, J.

1 .  Heard learned counsel for the petitioners, learned AGA for the State, Shri Pradeep Kumar Sharma, learned counsel holding brief of Shri Satyendra Kumar Singh, learned counsel for respondent no.4 and perused the record.

2. The instant writ petition has been filed by the petitioners with the prayer to quash the impugned first information report dated 12.07.2024 giving rise to Case Crime No. 133 of 2024, under Sections 498-A, 323, 504, 506, 376 IPC and Sections 3/4 of Dowry Prohibition Act, Police Station Manduadeeh, District Varuna (Commissionerate Varanasi).
3.

Learned counsel for the petitioners has submitted that respondent no.4 is the wife of petitioner no.1 and other petitioners are his family members and on account of matrimonial discord, the instant criminal proceedings has been initiated against the petitioners by respondent no.4 by lodging the impugned first information report.
4. Learned counsel for the petitioners has next submitted that the impugned first information report was challenged by the petitioners by filing the instant writ petition.

The said writ petition was heard by a Co-ordinate Bench of this Court and this Court after hearing the parties passed order dated 14.08.2024 referring the matter to the Mediation and Conciliation Centre of this Court in order to enable the parties to explore the possibility of resolving the dispute through mediation.

5. Pursuant to the said order dated 14.08.2024, the parties appeared before the Mediation and Conciliation Centre of this Court in order to explore the possibility of resolving the dispute through mediation and with the help of the Mediators, the dispute between the parties was amicably settled and a settlement agreement dated 15.04.2025 was drawn between the parties, a copy of which has been forwarded to this Court and placed on record, which shall form part of this writ petition.
6.

Learned counsel for petitioners has next submitted that pursuant to the said settlement agreement, petitioner no.1 has agreed to pay as sum of Rs.13,00,000/- to respondent no.4 in lieu of all her claims and dues.

Out of the said sum of Rs.13,00,000/-, a sum of Rs. 7,00,000/- has already been paid by petitioner no.1 to respondent no.4 through two separate demand draft bearing D.D.
No. 466901 dated 26.02.2025 for an amount of Rs.4,00,000/- and D.D. No.502900 dated 10.04.2025 for an amount of Rs.3,00,000/-.

The balance of the agreed amount of Rs.6,00,000/-
has been agreed to be paid on the date of passing of final decree under Section 13-B of the Hindu Marriage Act.

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the petitioners has made a statement at the Bar, on instructions, that at the time of passing of final decree under Section 13-B of the Hindu Marriage Act, petitioner no.1 shall pay the balance sum of Rs.6,00,000/- to respondent no. 4 in full and final settlement.

8. Learned counsel for the petitioners has next submitted that in view of the said settlement agreement and in order to maintain harmonious and cordial relations between the parties, the impugned first information report against the petitioners be quashed.

9. Learned counsel for respondent no.4 has also appeared and has acknowledged the said settlement agreement and has further submitted, on instructions, that an amount of Rs.7,00,000/- has already been received by respondent no.4 and the balance amount of Rs.6,00,000/- shall be paid to her on the date of passing of final decree under Section 13-B of the Hindu Marriage Act, as agreed upon.
He has further submitted, on instructions, that in view of the said settlement agreement, respondent no.4 has no objections, if the impugned FIR is quashed.
10. Learned AGA for the State could not dispute the aforesaid facts and has submitted that he has no objection, if the entire proceedings are quashed.

sentences.text: Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, as noted herein-above, and also the submissions made by learned counsel for the parties, this Court is of the considered opinion that no useful purpose would be served by prolonging the proceedings of the above mentioned case.

14. Accordingly, the impugned first information report dated 12.07.2024 giving rise to Case Crime No. 133 of 2024, under Sections 498-A, 323, 504, 506, 376 IPC and Sections 3/4 of Dowry Prohibition Act, Police Station Manduadeeh, District Varuna (Commissionerate Varanasi), is hereby quashed.
15. The instant writ petition stands allowed.
